title: Organizational Behavior and Management
lead: A guided route through people, teams, and organizations at work.

title: Organizational Behaviour Foundations
lead: How the meaning of work, human behaviour, organizational context, and management fit together.

title: Work Attitudes and Job Satisfaction
lead: Understand how workplace attitudes form, how satisfaction is evaluated, how people may respond to dissatisfaction, and how related job attitudes differ.

title: Personality at Work
lead: Understand personality as a relatively stable pattern whose expression depends on both the person and the work situation.

title: Values, Culture, and Person-Environment Fit
lead: Explain how values guide workplace choices, how people may fit jobs and organizational cultures, and how to read national-culture comparisons carefully.

title: Emotions and Moods
lead: Explain how emotions and moods shape workplace judgment, emotional labour, and responses to daily work events.

title: Managing Emotions at Work
lead: Use emotional awareness and context-sensitive response to support people and work without suppressing feelings or assuming what others feel.

title: Perception and Individual Decision Making
lead: Trace how people notice and interpret their environment, explain others’ behaviour, and decide what counts as a problem or a reasonable course of action.

title: Group Structure and Behaviour
lead: How group development, roles, norms, status, effort, cohesion, and diversity shape workplace behaviour and performance.

title: Group Decision-Making
lead: How groups gain from pooled knowledge, where decision processes can fail, and how three techniques trade off participation and outcomes.

title: Work Teams and Effectiveness
lead: Understand when teamwork fits, how teams are designed, and what the lecture model considers when discussing effectiveness.
